application_status.label: Annual cap applies
application_status.detail: Japan may issue up to 800 Working Holiday visas to Irish applicants per year. Acceptance closes once that number has been reached, so check current Embassy availability before applying.

change_control.review_note: Ireland ruleset verified against the current Embassy of Japan in Ireland Working Holiday and consular guidance.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: Irish citizen resident in Ireland at application

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: Up to two separate one-year Working Holiday stays

eligibility_rules.label: Are you an Irish citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Working Holiday route is for Irish citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you resident in Ireland at the time of application?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Irish Working Holiday applicants must be resident in Ireland when applying.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Irish Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Working Holiday route is for a holiday in Japan; work is incidental rather than the sole purpose.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependants without their own eligible status accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Dependants cannot accompany the applicant unless they independently hold an appropriate status.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health and no-criminal-record requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The programme requires good health and no criminal record.

funds_rule.input_label: Clear funds available for your Irish application (€)

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in Ireland — Dublin
jurisdiction.description: Working Holiday applications are made in person to the Embassy of Japan in Ireland. Current Consular Section guidance says visits should be booked in advance.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Irish applicants must be resident in Ireland and apply through the Embassy in Dublin.

options.label: I am resident in Ireland
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Ireland — Dublin
options.mission_detail: Apply in person at the Embassy of Japan in Ireland. Check the Consular Section's current appointment instructions before attending.

options.label: I am not resident in Ireland
options.mission_label: Irish Working Holiday route may not apply
options.mission_detail: The current programme requires Irish applicants to be resident in Ireland at the time of application.
options.issue: The Irish Working Holiday route requires the applicant to be resident in Ireland at the time of application.

document_checklist.title: Valid Irish passport
document_checklist.description: Submit a valid Irish passport with the Working Holiday application.

document_checklist.title: Completed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Complete the current official visa application form.

document_checklist.title: Recent passport photograph
document_checklist.description: Provide the current required photograph, approximately 35mm × 45mm and taken within the previous six months.

document_checklist.title: Curriculum Vitae
document_checklist.description: Prepare the current Working Holiday CV form / requested CV information.

document_checklist.title: Outline of intended stay and activities
document_checklist.description: Prepare a realistic outline of the intended length of stay and activities in Japan.

document_checklist.title: Written reason for applying
document_checklist.description: Prepare the typed A4 reason for requesting a Working Holiday visa.

document_checklist.title: Ticket and proof of funds
document_checklist.description: Show a return/onward ticket plus at least €1,600 clear funds, or at least €3,200 clear funds without the ticket evidence.

document_checklist.title: Overseas travel insurance
document_checklist.description: Provide a copy of an overseas travel insurance policy valid during the stay in Japan.

preparation_checklist.title: Check annual-cap availability
preparation_checklist.description: Up to 800 visas may be issued per year; acceptance closes when the cap is reached.

preparation_checklist.title: Confirm current Consular Section appointment procedure
preparation_checklist.description: Working Holiday applications are made in person; verify the Embassy's current visit/appointment instructions.

preparation_checklist.title: Check previous participation history
preparation_checklist.description: The programme now permits up to two separate Working Holiday stays in a lifetime.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final official-source check
preparation_checklist.description: Re-check the Embassy Working Holiday page immediately before preparing and lodging the application.
